tasks.task: Fix IterTools\Single::padLeft so it can emit from an arbitrarily long or infinite input after bounded lookahead. It may consume up to max(1, length) elements to determine padding before the first output, but must not request an additional element until the consumer advances. Preserve lazy validation of negative lengths, left padding of short/empty inputs, all original values of longer finite inputs, fill values, and sequential output keys. Stream::padLeft must retain its existing semantics.
tasks.verify: php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=tests/phpunit.xml tests/Single && php -d memory_limit=2G vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=tests/phpunit.xml tests/Stream
expectations: bounded first-output reads for length 0, 1, 3 using a source that throws on over-read
empty and short inputs padded on left
finite long input retained and sequential keys

tasks.task: Add public static MathPHP\Algebra::areCoprime(int $a, int $b): bool. Return whether the nonnegative mathematical gcd is one for all native signed integer inputs. Negative signs do not affect the result. Zero is coprime only to 1 or -1; (0,0) is false. PHP_INT_MIN must work without overflow, warnings, or exceptions, including paired with itself, zero, +/-1, 2, and PHP_INT_MAX. Keep existing gcd and extendedGcd behavior unchanged and document the API.
expectations: coprime and non-coprime ordinary pairs and signs

Preserve the existing public signature and ordinary results. Cover negative components, all-zero vectors, mixed scales, p=1, p=2, and larger finite p. Preserve NAN propagation and positive infinity for vectors containing an infinite component and no NAN. Do not change unrelated vector operations or define new behavior for p outside finite p >= 1.
